Mohammad Abdul Mamma, J : This appeal being heard on merit in presence of the learned Advocate for the appellant was allowed on 21. 5. 96 and the decree was drawn and signed on 3. 6. 96. 

 2. Now the respondent No. 1, the Assistant Custodian, Vested Property has come with this application under section 152 of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of the judgment and decree showing the Nane of Mr. Md. Shahidul Alam Chowdhury Advocate for respondent No. 1.
